open(p,'w').write('''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # On each patterned row, recolor the blank tail after its final foreground cell.
    for i, row in enumerate(out):
        vals = [v for v in row if v != 0]
        if not vals:
            continue
        # apply only rows in the lower/terminal pattern cluster, where the tail occurs
        if i >= len(out)//2 and row[-1] == 0:
            last = max(j for j, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0)
            if last + 1 < len(row):
                row[last+1:] = [1] * (len(row)-last-1)
    return out
''')
